rows.summary: AI metareasoning is currently bifurcated: established 'resource partition' models focus on computational efficiency, while emerging epistemological frameworks like 'Equity Bias' advocate for making foundational assumptions explicit and contestable. Current LLMs can support the transparency of these assumptions, but autonomous self-correction of foundational premises remains unproven.
